joblist.title: Manager - Growth Marketing
joblist.name: Marketing & Communications
joblist.description:
Primary Job Role

Fortude is looking for a Growth Marketing Manager to lead strategies that drive measurable business growth and generate high-quality demand across our markets.

The role will own the growth marketing agenda end-to-end, from market insight, positioning, and go-to-market strategy through integrated campaigns, performance marketing, website optimization, search and generative engine optimization, and lead generation. Working closely with regional teams across the Americas, UK & Europe, AMEA, and Australia, the Growth Marketing Manager will translate market expectations, customer insights, and business priorities into focused growth initiatives.

The role will combine analytics, experimentation, and commercial judgment to identify growth opportunities, optimize investment, and maximize pipeline impact, while using AI, automation, analytics, and marketing technology to improve decision-making, productivity, and scale.


Main Duties & Responsibilities

  • Lead Fortude’s growth marketing strategy, translating business objectives, market opportunities, customer insights, and priorities across the Americas, UK & Europe, Asia, and Australia into clear initiatives, campaigns, channels, and measurable outcomes.
  • Shape positioning, messaging, and go-to-market strategies for priority services, solutions, and products, partnering with sales, business, product/solution, content, and regional teams.
  • Lead integrated demand-generation programs across paid, owned, organic, and other relevant channels to build awareness, create demand, generate qualified leads, and contribute to pipeline growth.
  • Own performance marketing across LinkedIn, Google, Meta, and other relevant platforms, including audience strategy, channel mix, budgets, optimization, lead quality, conversion, and ROI.
  • Drive the website as a growth channel, overseeing landing pages, customer journeys, CRO, SEO, and GEO to strengthen visibility and increase qualified inbound demand.
  • Lead growth analytics and performance measurement across campaigns, website, CRM, and pipeline to assess effectiveness, identify opportunities and bottlenecks, and guide strategic and investment decisions.
  • Establish a disciplined experimentation approach across audiences, messaging, creative, offers, channels, and conversion journeys; test, learn, and scale what works.
  • Own the marketing technology stack, including CRM and automation platforms, ensuring the right systems, integrations, data flows, and workflows are in place to support segmentation, lead management, nurturing, campaign measurement, and scalable marketing execution.
  • Drive the use of AI and automation to improve insight generation, personalization, campaign development, reporting, workflow efficiency, and marketing productivity.
  • Manage priorities, budgets, and team execution, collaborating across creative, content, lead generation, sales, and regional teams while fostering a data-driven culture of accountability and continuous improvement.


Experience

  • Proven senior-level experience in B2B growth marketing, digital marketing, demand generation, or performance marketing, with a track record of driving measurable business outcomes.
  • Practical experience applying AI and automation to research, campaign development, content and creative workflows, reporting, productivity, and optimization.

 

Technical Knowledge

  • Strong understanding of positioning, messaging, go-to-market strategy, integrated campaigns, and demand generation.
  • Deep expertise in performance marketing and digital acquisition, including audience strategy, paid media, optimization, budget management, conversion, and ROI.
  • Strong analytical and commercial acumen, with the ability to interpret marketing, website, CRM, funnel, and pipeline data and turn insights into action.
  • Strong understanding of website optimization, CRO, SEO, GEO, digital journeys, and A/B testing, supported by experience with analytics and dashboarding tools.
  • Experience with CRM and marketing automation platforms, preferably HubSpot or equivalent, including segmentation, workflows, lead management, nurturing, attribution, and campaign measurement. Familiarity with WordPress and Elementor is an advantage.

 

Qualifications

  • Degree/postgraduate diploma in marketing, digital marketing, business or a related qualification.
  • Relevant certifications in Google Ads, LinkedIn Marketing, Meta Advertising, analytics, SEO, or related areas are an advantage.

 

Behavioral Competencies

  • Communication
  • Teamwork
  • Digital Mindset
  • Operational Excellence
  • Analytical Ability
  • Customer Centricity
  • Business and Market Acumen
  • Empathy
  • Growth Mindset

 

Equal Opportunity Employer

Everyone can grow at Fortude; regardless of their identity. Join us, and be a part of an organization, where we’re all proud to belong.

The role is accountable for service quality, operational governance, customer satisfaction, team leadership, support readiness, commercial performance, and continuous improvement across global customer engagements. The successful candidate will lead consultants and engineers supporting enterprise cloud, analytics, infrastructure, and business application platforms across multiple geographies and time zones.

joblist.description:
Primary Job Role

Fortude is looking for a talented, self-driven Consultant who has a passion for data to join our dynamic, dedicated analytics team. You will be involved in design, development and implementation of data engineering solutions that feed into the analytics solutions we provide our customers across multiple geographies. 


Main Duties and Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, and maintain scalable end-to-end data pipelines integrating multiple source systems into modern data platforms. 
  • Develop and curate data across Bronze, Silver, and Gold layers, ensuring accuracy, completeness, traceability, and alignment with business requirements. 
  • Contribute to the design and implementation of data warehouses and lakehouses, including data integration, orchestration, dimensional models, and analytical data assets. 
  • Build and optimize data transformations using SQL, Spark SQL, PySpark, and related engineering frameworks. 
  • Develop semantic models and analytics-ready datasets in Microsoft Fabric and Power BI to enable efficient reporting and self-service analytics. 
  • Apply data quality, governance, security, validation, and reconciliation controls across data pipelines and curated assets. 
  • Collaborate with functional, BI, engineering, and client stakeholders to clarify requirements and translate them into practical technical solutions. 
  • Own assigned workstreams, provide accurate delivery estimates, identify risks and dependencies, and contribute to project planning and technical documentation. 
  • Review deliverables, support junior team members through technical guidance, and contribute to reusable standards and engineering best practices. 
  • Monitor, troubleshoot, and optimize solution performance, and support testing, deployment, production stabilization, and incident resolution. 


Education & Experience 

  • Bachelor’s degree in Data Science, Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, Analytics, or a related discipline. 
  • Minimum 4 years of relevant post-qualification experience in Data Engineering. 
  • Two or more of the following certifications  
  •        Microsoft Certified: Azure Enterprise Data Analyst Associate  
  •      Microsoft Certified: Power BI Data Analyst Associate  
  •       Databricks: Lakehouse Data Engineer Associate  
  •        Microsoft Certified: Fabric Data Engineer Associate 
  •      Microsoft Certified: Fabric Analytics Engineer Associate 
  •       Microsoft Certified: Azure Databricks Data Engineer Associate 


Core Skills & Qualifications 

  • Advanced SQL expertise with strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities, including complex query optimization and performance tuning. 
  • Hands-on experience with Spark SQL and PySpark for distributed data processing and production-grade data engineering. 
  • Strong understanding of ETL/ELT frameworks, dimensional modeling, medallion architecture and modern data warehousing and lakehouse concepts. 
  • Practical experience designing, developing, and maintaining data pipelines using Databricks, Microsoft Fabric, Azure Data Factory, Synapse Analytics, or similar platforms. 
  • Experience with Microsoft Fabric components such as Data Factory, Lakehouse, Warehouse, notebooks, semantic models, and OneLake is preferred. 
  • Working knowledge of Power BI and DAX, with an understanding of end-to-end BI and analytics solution delivery. 
  • Ability to interpret business requirements, contribute to solution design, and independently deliver well-tested technical components. 

 

Added Advantages 

  • Prior experience in apparel, manufacturing, retail, supply chain, or other domain-driven analytics environments. 
  • Experience with Change Data Capture, incremental processing, streaming, or near-real-time data integration patterns. 
  • Exposure to SQL Server-based data warehousing, including Integration Services and Analysis Services.

joblist.title: Consultant - Digital Business Architecture (Finance) - Brandix Digital
joblist.name: Brandix Digital - Operations
joblist.description:
Primary job role

As a Consultant – Digital Business Architecture, you will support and deliver finance-focused process optimisation and digital transformation initiatives across the Brandix group. You will gather and analyse business requirements, map current-state finance processes, identify improvement opportunities, and help design solutions that leverage digital tools to deliver clear, measurable value. This is a hands-on role for someone early in their transformation journey who is eager to grow into a broader advisory position.


About the team

The Digital Business Architecture team sits at the intersection of finance, business operations, and technology. In this role you will help translate finance and business challenges into digital solutions — optimising processes, driving measurable ROI, and connecting the right tools to the right requirements. You will not be writing code, but you will be the person who understands the business deeply, shapes the solution, and ensures the technical teams build the right thing.


Key responsibilities

  • Work with finance and business stakeholders to understand, document, and analyse existing finance processes and pain points.
  • Support process optimisation projects end-to-end — from requirement gathering and current-state mapping through to solution design, testing, and rollout.
  • Identify opportunities to streamline, automate, and improve finance processes, and help quantify the expected ROI.
  • Assess how digital tools and platforms can be applied to specific business requirements, and clearly link the right tool to the right need.
  • Translate business requirements into clear functional documentation that technical teams can act on.
  • Act as a bridge between business users and technical / implementation teams, ensuring solutions meet the intended objective.
  • Support user training, adoption, and change management activities during and after implementation.
  • Track project deliverables, maintain accurate documentation, and keep stakeholders informed of progress.
  • Work from different Brandix centre locations as required by project needs.


Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Finance or Business Management.
  • A professional qualification in finance — CIMA, ACCA, CA Sri Lanka, or CPA — is mandatory (part-qualified candidates with strong progress may be considered at this level).


Experience

  • 3+ years of work experience in a corporate finance, business analytics, corporate planning, or management accounting role.
  • Exposure to or involvement in process improvement or transformation initiatives is a strong advantage.


The person we’re looking for

  • Solid understanding of core finance processes and how they operate in a corporate environment.
  • Experience contributing to process optimisation projects with a clear focus on ROI and measurable outcomes.
  • Understanding of digital tools and how they can be applied to solve business problems — the ability to connect a tool to a requirement (not as a developer, but as someone who sees the fit).
  • A natural problem solver who can figure out how to get things done and navigate ambiguity.
  • A strong communicator who can articulate solutions clearly to both business and technical audiences.
  • Able to understand business requirements thoroughly, with strong attention to detail.
  • Comfortable networking and building relationships across a diverse stakeholder base.
  • Willing and able to work from different Brandix centre locations based on project needs.


Why join us

You will be part of Fortude’s Digital Business Architecture team, working closely with the Brandix Digital team on transformation initiatives that have real, measurable impact across one of the region’s leading organisations. It is an opportunity to combine your finance expertise with digital problem-solving, work alongside diverse stakeholders, and grow as a trusted transformation advisor.

  • Customer Centricity
  • Business and Market Acumen
  • Psychological Safety
  • Empathy
  • Growth Mindset and Learning Agility
  • Ethical & Vigilant
  • Operational Excellence
  • Teamwork
  • Analytical Thinking
